newsitem.title: UK: Cathay ups ex-UK air cargo rates from Apri.
newsitem.headline: Cathay ups ex-UK air cargo rates from Apri.

text.p: Cathay Pacific Airways Ltd will raise its ex-UK air cargo rates by an average of five percent from April 1, the airline's UK air cargo manager, Mark Olney told Reuters.

The existing cargofuel surcharge will remain in place, he added. Olney added that its existing Boeing 747-200 freighter service from London to the Far East will be also be rerouted via Dubai, instead of through Bahrain. --Reuters Air Cargo Newsroom Tel+44-171-542-7706 Fax 5017
